intent: Fix CWSP-shell wallpaper not painting (asset 404 + canvas render defects in image.ts).
lastDone: ROOT CAUSE 1 (asset 404): shell builds never served /assets/wallpaper.jpg — viteStaticCopy dest was outDir/assets (static-copy joins root-relative path → assets/assets/wallpaper.jpg) in createHostSpaConfig, and shared/vite.config.js (PWA/dist) did not copy wallpapers at all. Fixed both (dest=outDir/dist root) + dev-server route for /assets/wallpaper.jpg.

ROOT CAUSE 2 (canvas render): image.ts #render passed the rafYield resolution value (rAF timestamp) as $renderPass(whatIsReady) → guard rejected the pass → blank canvas. Now the payload id is passed explicitly.
ROOT CAUSE 3: bindCache was keyed by the prototype method ($renderPass) → a second ui-canvas reused the FIRST canvas's bound context (visible canvas stayed blank). Cache is now keyed per element.

ROOT CAUSE 4: createImageBitmapCache used `blob instanceof OffscreenCanvas/Image` → ReferenceError when the global is missing (WebView) → source marked failed → no wallpaper. Added typeof-guarded probes.
RO create guarded by try/catch (one throw used to abort the whole init), RO falls back to contentBoxSize × dpr when devicePixelContentBoxSize is missing.

Verified: dist/assets/wallpaper.jpg, build/vds-main/assets/wallpaper.jpg, build/capacitor/web/assets/wallpaper.jpg all present; jsdom smoke shows drawImage called on both canvases with real 2160×4800 size.
next: Check on device/PWA: wallpaper paints on first frame (no rotation needed); custom IDB wallpaper still paints.
